Independent arithmetic oracle: each 32-byte block from bytes(range(256)) has exactly 32 distinct values giving Shannon entropy = log2(32) = 5.0 bits/byte; the classify_block function in entropy.rs returns code 4 for entropy in [4.5, 7.0]; expected block count = math.ceil(256 / 32) = 8. Oracle is hand-derived from the published Shannon formula, not copied from production code.
